calendar_design: D replaces raw year/month/day with four calendar-cycle coordinates. This bundles cyclic encoding with absolute-year removal; ablation cannot isolate these effects.

rejected_transformations.wind_vectors: Reference/from-to convention undocumented and measurements extremely sparse
rejected_transformations.spatial_distance_or_bins: No documented coordinate datum/projection or scientifically justified region/site bins
rejected_transformations.environmental_log_or_interactions: No prespecified scientific/measurement rationale for additional transforms; tree models already allow nonlinear associations
rejected_transformations.additional_sensors: pH, turbidity, TDS, oxygen, chlorophyll-a unavailable
